# dsh-kiro-proxy
**English** | 中文
Kiro (AWS CodeWhisperer / Amazon Q) as a DeepSeek Harness provider route, plus an OpenAI- and Anthro
pic-compatible reverse proxy in front of the same account.
No API key, no hand-edited `cordis.yml`: install the bundle and the `kiro-proxy` route appears. If K
iro IDE or the Kiro CLI is already signed in on this machine, chat works immediately.
This is an independent integration, not affiliated with or endorsed by AWS. Kiro is an Amazon tradem
ent integration, not affiliated with or endorsed by AWS. Kiro is an Amazon trademark; see NOTICE.md.
## Install
**Desktop application.** Open **Plugins** in the sidebar, choose **Add plugin**, and paste:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Then **Enable now**. A GitHub spec is exactly what that dialog takes. The `desktop` profile belongs
to the Electron application, so `dsh plugin --profile desktop …` is refused on purpose — in the desk
top build the dialog is the only way in.
**Every other profile (web, tui, headless).** Same spec, through the CLI:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
**Pin a release** when an install must not drift. The tag and any commit work the same way:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
A local checkout installs the same way — paste its absolute path into the same dialog, or pass it to
`dsh plugin add`. A local install is a link, so edits apply on reload.
There is nothing to build: `index.js` and `client.js` are the shipped artifacts and the package decl
ares no `prepare` script, so `pnpm` installs it in seconds on a machine with no toolchain.
## What it does
1. **Provider route `kiro-proxy`** — pick a Kiro model in a session and the turn streams straight fr

om Kiro: text, out-of-band reasoning, tool calls, token accounting.
2. **Reverse proxy** — `POST /v1
/chat/completions` (OpenAI), `POST /v1/messages` (Anthropic), `GET /v1/models`, so any CLI speaking

one of those protocols reaches the same Kiro account.
3. **Settings → Kiro Proxy** — usage first, th
en accounts, model allowlist, proxy URL/key, connection settings.
## Credentials
Nothing is baked in. Priority order:

1. Accounts stored by this plugin (`$DSH_HOME/storages/kiro-proxy/accounts.json`)
2. Whatever Kiro I
DE / CLI already signed in with (`~/.aws/sso/cache/kiro-auth-token.json`)
Kiro-owned files are read, never rewritten; a refreshed Kiro token stays in memory. Files this plugi
n writes are mode `0600`.
Seven ways to add an account, from **Settings → Kiro Proxy → 连接**:
| Method | What happens |

| AWS Builder ID | AWS OIDC device code; open the link, enter the code, approve |
| IAM Identity Cen
ter | Same device code against your instance: needs the portal URL (`https://<org>.awsapps.com/start

`) and its region |
| Google / GitHub | Kiro's own social device code, approved on `app.kiro.dev` |

| Refresh token | Pasted token, validated locally; refreshes through Kiro's auth service |
| API key

| Pasted `ksk_` key; sent with `TokenType: API_KEY` |
| External IdP | Pasted Microsoft Entra / ext
ernal-IdP JSON; refreshes at its own endpoint |

## Using it outside the Harness
The settings page shows the base URLs and the generated proxy key:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
The key is not enforced by default (the proxy listens on loopback). Set `requireProxyKey: true` befo
re exposing the Harness beyond loopback.
## Configuration
`Settings → Kiro Proxy` writes `$DSH_HOME/storages/kiro-proxy/settings.json`. A profile row wins ove
r the page, so a deployment can pin values:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
| Field | Default | Meaning |
| `proxyUrl` | direct | HTTP(S) `CONNECT` egress for every Kiro request. Kiro authorizes model famil

ies by egress. |
| `region` | token region | Selects `q.<region>` / `codewhisperer.<region>`. |
| `p
rofileArn` | account default | CodeWhisperer profile; discovered with `ListAvailableProfiles` when a

bsent. |
| `maxContextWindow` | `200000` | Capacity reported to the Harness. The catalog advertises
1M, but the data plane answers `Input is too long.`, so reporting 1M would stop the Harness from eve

r compacting. Raise it deliberately. |
| `enabledModels` | all | Filters the model picker **and** `/

v1/models`. Requests for a disabled model still pass. |
| `requireProxyKey` | `false` | Enforce the

`kr-…` key on the proxy surfaces. |
| `fallbackOnEmpty` | `true` | Try the next model when a model a

nswers with an empty stream. |
| `fallbackModels` | built-in list | Candidate order for that fallbac

k; only ids present in the account catalog are used. |
| `maxConcurrency` | `2` | In-flight request

cap; the rest queue. |
| `retryAttempts` | `3` | Retry rounds across both data planes. |
| `maxReque
stChars` | `320000` | Character budget for one request; the oldest turns are dropped and oversized t

ool results clipped. |
| `autoContinue` | `true` | Send one more `continue` turn when a stream produ

ced reasoning but nothing visible. |
| `maxContinuations` | `2` | Upper bound on those automatic con

but nothing visible. |
| `maxContinuations` | `2` | Upper bound on those automatic continuations. |
